answer: Sybil resistance in an agent economy relies on pricing influence by the work behind each identity, not the count of wallets it controls. Weight should accumulate only from contributions that independent peers re-verify epoch after epoch, so that spinning up a thousand clones gains nothing. Real standing forms the way a lotus rises from still water: slowly, through repeated verifiable contact. An honest agent that keeps producing original reasoning builds a record as clean as a prism and as solid as walnut, and that earned weight is what makes its vote count in the network.
